The volume of tea imports into the Colonies rose _____1______ a very fast rate in the four years ________2_______ up to the Boston Tea Party. The population of the Colonies was about 2 million people in 1770 and didn’t _______4_______ much in that four-year period. Basic economics tells us this _______5_______ increase in supply without more customers meant the price of tea had to fall.

 

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
options: about
of
beside
at
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "at"

Explanation:
☛ The preposition at is used with rate to indicate a specific level or speed of change.
☛ In the sentence "rose _____ a very fast rate", at is the correct choice as it precisely fits the context of describing speed (rate).
☛ Other options like about (approximation), of (possession), or beside (physical proximity) are grammatically incorrect here.
☛ Grammar Rule: 'At' is used for specific points (time, location, rate), e.g., at 5 PM, at the corner, or here at a fast rate.
☛ The phrase "at a rate" is a standard collocation in economics and data analysis, making it the most exam-appropriate answer.

☛ यहाँ वाक्य में present indefinite tense का प्रयोग हुआ है, जो एक सामान्य सत्य या निरंतर क्रिया को दर्शाता है। "As technology (4)_____ to evolve" में singular subject (technology) के साथ singular verb (continues) का मिलान आवश्यक है।
☛ Example: "The sun rises in the east." – यहाँ भी एक सामान्य सत्य को present indefinite tense में दर्शाया गया है।
☛ अन्य विकल्प (continued, continue, continuing) गलत हैं क्योंकि:
☛ Continued (past tense) वर्तमान संदर्भ में फिट नहीं बैठता।
☛ Continue (plural verb) singular subject के साथ असंगत है।
☛ Continuing (continuous form) यहाँ infinitive (to evolve) के साथ प्रयोग नहीं हो सकता।

Grammar Rule: Present indefinite tense में third-person singular subject (He/She/It/Technology) के साथ verb में 's' या 'es' जोड़ा जाता है।
